ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, there are two input terminals A and B on the left side. A and B respectively branch into the first AND gate on the left with a small output inversion circle, so this gate is a NAND gate, and its output forms an intermediate signal. This intermediate signal is then respectively sent into the upper and lower two NAND gates: the other input of the upper NAND gate comes from A, and the other input of the lower NAND gate comes from B. The outputs of the upper and lower two NAND gates then jointly enter the rightmost NAND gate, and the rightmost output is labeled F. Reasoning: Let the output of the left NAND gate be N, then N = ¬(A·B). The output of the upper NAND gate X = ¬(A·N), and the output of the lower NAND gate Y = ¬(B·N). The final output F = ¬(X·Y). Substitute N = ¬(A·B): X = ¬(A·¬(A·B)) = ¬(A·¬B), Y = ¬(B·¬(A·B)) = ¬(¬A·B). Therefore F = ¬[¬(A·¬B) · ¬(¬A·B)] = A·¬B + ¬A·B. This is exactly XOR logic.

method.method_draft: First describe the circuit structure: inputs A and B enter a left NAND gate, producing N = ¬(AB). This signal N is sent to two NAND gates: the upper one also receives A, giving X = ¬(A N), and the lower one also receives B, giving Y = ¬(B N). The final NAND combines X and Y, so F = ¬(XY). Substitute N = ¬(AB): X = ¬(A¬(AB)) = ¬(A¬B), Y = ¬(B¬(AB)) = ¬(¬A B). Therefore F = ¬[¬(A¬B) · ¬(¬A B)] = A¬B + ¬A B, which is the XOR function.

图像描述：图中左侧有两个输入端 A 和 B。A、B 分别分支进入左侧第一个带输出反相小圆点的与门，因此该门是 NAND 门，其输出形成中间信号。这个中间信号再分别送入上下两个 NAND 门：上方 NAND 门的另一个输入来自 A，下方 NAND 门的另一个输入来自 B。上下两个 NAND 门的输出再共同进入最右侧的 NAND 门，最右侧输出标为 F。

推理：设左侧 NAND 门输出为 N，则 N = ¬(A·B)。上方 NAND 门输出 X = ¬(A·N)，下方 NAND 门输出 Y = ¬(B·N)。最终输出 F = ¬(X·Y)。代入 N = ¬(A·B)：X = ¬(A·¬(A·B)) = ¬(A·¬B)，Y = ¬(B·¬(A·B)) = ¬(¬A·B)。因此 F = ¬[¬(A·¬B) · ¬(¬A·B)] = A·¬B + ¬A·B。这正是异或逻辑。
